::: {.page-lede}
My research spans two primary areas: policing (with emphases on officer stress and physiology, use of force and decision making, and public opinion) and active shooter preparedness and response. Use the search, topic, and year filters below to narrow the list. Summaries are written for a general audience. For full abstracts and citation information, use the DOI or PDF links.
:::

```{r setup}
library(yaml)
library(htmltools)

source("scripts/topic_labels.R")
source("scripts/site_helpers.R")

pubs <- yaml::read_yaml("data/publications.yaml")
ids  <- pub_ids(pubs)

stats <- tryCatch(
  yaml::read_yaml("data/scholar_stats.yaml"),
  error = function(e) list(total_citations = "--", h_index = "--", i10_index = "--")
)

# Sort all pubs by year descending for the flat list
years_all    <- sapply(pubs, function(p) as.integer(p$year))
ord          <- order(years_all, decreasing = TRUE)
pubs_sorted  <- pubs[ord]
ids_sorted   <- ids[ord]
unique_years <- sort(unique(years_all), decreasing = TRUE)
```

```{r stat-band}
render_stat_band(
  list(
    list(value = format(stats$total_citations, big.mark = ","), label = "Citations"),
    list(value = stats$h_index,   label = "h-index"),
    list(value = stats$i10_index, label = "i10-index")
  ),
  caption = "Google Scholar, updated weekly."
)
```

```{r filter-bar}
year_opts <- c(
  list(tags$option(value = "all", "All Years")),
  lapply(unique_years, function(y) tags$option(value = as.character(y), as.character(y)))
)

# Pills come from the topics actually present in publications.yaml, so a
# newly tagged paper always gets a filter without editing this page.
topic_pills <- c(
  list(tags$button(type = "button", class = "topic-pill active", `data-topic` = "all",
                   `aria-pressed` = "true", "All Topics")),
  lapply(topics_in_use(pubs), function(slug) {
    tags$button(type = "button", class = "topic-pill", `data-topic` = slug,
                `aria-pressed` = "false",
                tags$i(`aria-hidden` = "true"), topic_label_for(slug))
  })
)

div(
  class = "pub-filter",
  div(
    class = "pub-filter-row pub-filter-top",
    div(
      class = "pub-search",
      tags$label(`for` = "pub-search-input", class = "visually-hidden", "Search publications"),
      tags$input(type = "search", id = "pub-search-input", class = "pub-search-input",
                 placeholder = "Search title, author, or journal", autocomplete = "off")
    ),
    div(
      class = "pub-year-wrap",
      tags$label(`for` = "pub-year-filter", class = "pub-year-label", "Year"),
      do.call(tags$select, c(
        list(id = "pub-year-filter", class = "pub-year-select", `aria-label` = "Filter by year"),
        year_opts
      ))
    )
  ),
  do.call(tags$div, c(list(class = "pub-topic-pills", role = "group", `aria-label` = "Filter by topic"), topic_pills)),
  div(
    class = "pub-count",
    `aria-live` = "polite",
    "Showing ",
    tags$span(id = "pub-visible-count", as.character(length(pubs_sorted))),
    sprintf(" of %d publications", length(pubs_sorted))
  )
)
```

```{r render-flat-list}
div(
  class = "pub-list pub-list-full",
  tagList(lapply(seq_along(pubs_sorted), function(i) {
    render_pub_row(pubs_sorted[[i]], id = ids_sorted[i])
  })),
  div(class = "pub-empty", hidden = NA, "No publications match those filters.")
)
```

```{r jsonld, results="asis"}
source("scripts/jsonld_helpers.R")
emit_publications_jsonld(pubs_sorted)
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  document.documentElement.classList.add('js');

  const yearSelect  = document.getElementById('pub-year-filter');
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('pub-search-input');
  const pills       = document.querySelectorAll('.topic-pill');
  const entries     = document.querySelectorAll('.pub-list-full .pub-row');
  const countEl     = document.getElementById('pub-visible-count');
  const emptyEl     = document.querySelector('.pub-empty');

  let activeTopic = 'all';

  function apply() {
    const yr = yearSelect.value;
    const q  = (searchInput.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    let visible = 0;
    let lastYear = null;

    entries.forEach(el => {
      const topics = (el.dataset.topics || '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      const year   = el.dataset.year || '';

      const topicMatch  = activeTopic === 'all' || topics.includes(activeTopic);
      const yearMatch   = yr === 'all' || year === yr;
      const searchMatch = !q || (el.dataset.search || '').includes(q);

      if (topicMatch && yearMatch && searchMatch) {
        el.style.display = '';
        // Show the year in the margin only where it changes, like a timeline.
        el.classList.toggle('is-year-first', year !== lastYear);
        lastYear = year;
        visible++;
      } else {
        el.style.display = 'none';
      }
    });

    countEl.textContent = visible;
    if (emptyEl) emptyEl.hidden = visible !== 0;
  }

  function setTopic(topic) {
    let found = false;
    pills.forEach(b => {
      const on = b.dataset.topic === topic;
      if (on) found = true;
      b.classList.toggle('active', on);
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
    if (!found) return setTopic('all');
    activeTopic = topic;
    apply();
  }

  yearSelect.addEventListener('change', apply);
  searchInput.addEventListener('input', apply);
  pills.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => setTopic(btn.dataset.topic)));

  // Long summaries start collapsed to three lines with a toggle.
  entries.forEach(el => {
    const box = el.querySelector('.pub-summary');
    if (!box) return;
    box.classList.add('is-clamped');
    const p = box.querySelector('p');
    if (p.scrollHeight <= p.clientHeight + 2) { box.classList.remove('is-clamped'); return; }
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.className = 'pub-more';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    btn.textContent = 'Read full summary';
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = box.classList.toggle('is-clamped') === false;
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
      btn.textContent = open ? 'Show less' : 'Read full summary';
    });
    box.appendChild(btn);
  });

  // Deep links from the home page: #topic=<slug> pre-selects a topic,
  // #pub-... opens that paper's summary and scrolls to it.
  function fromHash() {
    const h = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1));
    if (h.startsWith('topic=')) {
      setTopic(h.slice(6));
      const bar = document.querySelector('.pub-filter');
      if (bar) bar.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
    } else if (h.startsWith('pub-')) {
      const el = document.getElementById(h);
      if (!el) return;
      const box = el.querySelector('.pub-summary.is-clamped');
      const btn = el.querySelector('.pub-more');
      if (box && btn) btn.click();
      el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
    }
  }

  apply();
  fromHash();
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', fromHash);
})();
</script>
```
